description: Main window capability. Deny-by-default: grants zero IPC permissions. The M1 shell adds NATIVE lifecycle behavior only (tray, single-instance guard, opt-in autostart, graceful shutdown, journal-backed crash recovery); the WebView still has no invokable surface, no Tauri command is registered, and no source-visibility/input-mute consent surface exists. Future permissions must be added explicitly with security review.
